data.name: Dallas group removed from outside City Hall raises First Amendment concerns ahead of GOP convention
data.notes: KERA directly quotes Dallas Police Senior Public Information Officer Corbin Rubinson describing the First Amendment Activity form as informational rather than a permit request and explaining when activity may be routed to the Office of Special Events.

sources.title: Dallas group removed from outside City Hall raises First Amendment concerns ahead of GOP convention

summary: KERA reports City/DPD explanations distinguishing Dallas's First Amendment Activity form from a special-event permit: the form informs DPD of planned demonstrations, while activities meeting special-event criteria can be routed to the Office of Special Events.
title: KERA — Dallas protest permit and First Amendment activity process
